players.product: BUZZ HPC GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB200 / GB300 / B200 / H200 clusters in Bell AI Fabric data centers in Canada) plus HPC colocation conversions of owned sites (Boden Sweden, Toronto gigafactory)

quarterly_data.signal: HIVE's 8-K (Paraguay release, June 22, 2026): at Yguazu, Paraguay, where HIVE has a 100 MW substation under construction for a planned HPC/AI Gigafactory, civil works are complete with commissioning expected this summer; the substation is expected to be energized in September 2026, with construction of a new Tier-III data center beginning Fall 2026 and a ready-for-service date in H2 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: 100 MW substation energized September 2026 (expected); Tier-III data center construction from Fall 2026, ready for service H2 2027

quarterly_data.signal: HIVE's 8-K: the Boden Municipal Council approved HIVE's acquisition of its leased 'Big Boden 32 MW data center' in Boden, Sweden from Bodens Utvecklings AB (the facility has anchored HIVE's Swedish operations since 2018), moving HIVE from tenant to owner; upon closing HIVE will advance the site toward Tier III standards, including support for NVIDIA's latest GPU architectures for AI training and inference. Closing remains subject to customary conditions.
quarterly_data.figure: Big Boden 32 MW data center acquisition approved

connects_to.relationship: GPU cloud compute (NVIDIA GB200 cluster at Bell AI Fabric's Merritt, B.C. facility) on which Cohere operates its foundation models

contracts.signal: HIVE's BUZZ HPC closed a sovereign AI GPU contract 'with Bell AI Fabric for Cohere Inc.': BUZZ HPC executed a three-year GPU cloud contract with a total contract value of approximately USD $220 million and will deploy its sovereign AI cloud and GPU cluster infrastructure at Bell's purpose-built facility in Merritt, British Columbia, providing the high-performance compute layer on which Cohere will operate its foundation models and enterprise AI solutions for government and corporate customers across Canada. CEO: the contracted HPC revenue target has surpassed $100m; the NVIDIA GB200 deployment is expected to go live in late 2026 to early 2027, adding approximately $70m of contracted ARR to the current realized $35m ARR.
contracts.value: approximately USD $220 million total contract value (three years); ~$70m contracted ARR

players.product: GB200 / GB300 / Vera Rubin GPU systems

connects_to.relationship: NVIDIA GPU systems (Grace Blackwell GB200 NVL72) procured by HIVE's BUZZ HPC for its GPU cloud, delivered via OEM Hypertec

contracts.signal: HIVE's 8-K: through BUZZ HPC, HIVE has procured NVIDIA AI infrastructure powered by 2,304 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 rack-scale systems interconnected with NVIDIA Quantum InfiniBand scale-out networking, built to NVIDIA reference architecture standards with advanced liquid cooling, for the Cohere deployment at Bell's Merritt, B.C. facility; Hypertec is delivering the bespoke GPU server solution (hardware procurement, system integration, installation, commissioning and OEM support).
